name: Westchester County Airport

curfew.v: a voluntary request not to fly between midnight and 06:30 every day, not a mandatory curfew
curfew.quote: Operators please note: this is not a mandatory curfew, but a voluntary program.

noise.v: six noise programmes, including a voluntary restraint from flying, a programme for high-noise events of 90 dBA or more, no intersection take-offs, and limits on maintenance run-ups and reverse thrust
noise.quote: there are no fines, penalties or aircraft restrictions associated with this program

customs.v: US Customs and Border Protection clears arriving aircraft 7 days a week, 07:30-23:15 Eastern Time, at the Signature-West, Million Air or Atlantic-East FBOs; request permission to land at least 2 hours before leaving the foreign airport
customs.quote: Arriving aircraft will be processed at Signature-West, Million Air or Atlantic-East FBOs.

handling.v: FBOs named by CBP for customs clearance: Signature-West, Million Air and Atlantic-East
handling.quote: Arriving aircraft will be processed at Signature-West, Million Air or Atlantic-East FBOs.
